THE INVESTMENT BEHIND THE RESULT

Good software starts
long before the flash.

We have invested heavily in the equipment, workshop facilities and development time needed to understand what a calibration actually does.

At Boostech Bloemfontein, our own calibrated dynamometer is part of that process. It gives us a controlled environment to measure output, assess the shape of the torque curve and refine the way an engine delivers its performance.

In-house development means working through the details: identifying the ECU and software version, understanding the vehicle’s hardware, evaluating changes and checking the result. The goal is useful performance you can feel in everyday driving, towing and touring.

Our local development is supported by the wider Boostech network’s shared experience across engines, software versions and operating conditions.

PERFORMANCE WITH A PURPOSE

More capability.
Where you use it.

01 / EVERYDAY DRIVING

More natural response

A calibration matched to your engine can improve acceleration and make its usable torque easier to access, with progressive delivery at the pedal.

02 / TOWING & TOURING

Useful pulling power

Focus on the part of the rev range you use under load. Engine torque delivery and transmission behaviour are considered together where the platform supports it.

03 / EFFICIENT OPERATION

Make the most of each tank

Better use of the engine’s working range may help fuel economy at comparable loads and speeds. Actual consumption depends on the vehicle, route and how you drive; savings are not guaranteed.

YOUR QUESTIONS

Know before
you book.

What is ECU tuning?

ECU tuning changes the software calibration that controls the engine. On a compatible vehicle, coordinated changes to torque request, air and fuel control can improve usable performance and response. The correct approach depends on the engine, ECU, transmission and hardware.

Why invest in your own calibrated dynamometer?

It gives us a controlled, repeatable environment for development and comparison. We can evaluate the torque curve and power delivery while refining a calibration, instead of judging the result only by a peak number or how fast the vehicle feels.

Will my vehicle need dyno testing?

The testing plan is agreed for the specific vehicle and the work required. Development, fault investigation and modified setups can have different requirements from a supported application using established development. Ask us what testing and reporting your quote includes.

How much power or torque will I gain?

We confirm a realistic target once we know the exact vehicle and setup. Fuel, condition, ECU version and hardware all affect the outcome. Photographs show workshop applications; they are not promises of a particular power figure.

Can you tune for towing and everyday driving?

Yes. Tell us how the vehicle is used so that the proposed calibration can focus on useful torque, progressive response and suitable delivery under load. Gearbox-related changes depend on the platform and available ECU or TCU support.

Do I need an exhaust before a Stage 1 remap?

Many compatible, mechanically standard vehicles can use an appropriate Stage 1 calibration. Hardware requirements are assessed individually. If the vehicle is already modified, the software must be matched to that setup.

What if my vehicle already has a fault or another tune?

Include any warning lights, symptoms, tuning boxes or existing software in your enquiry. Mechanical faults need proper assessment; a remap is not a repair for a boost leak, worn component or transmission problem.

How do I book ECU tuning in Bloemfontein?

Complete the enquiry form with your vehicle details and typed location. Choose WhatsApp or email, review the prepared message and send it to Pieter. Compatibility, the proposed work and pricing are confirmed before booking.
